title: Signal Garden runtime scene, support geometry, and viewport in a local Studio Play session
scope: Runtime scene construction, script boot, switch-support geometry, initial Echo state, and one live viewport capture in a single local desktop Studio Play session. This does not cover player input, the full gameplay loop, multiplayer, touch/controller input, device performance, saving, publishing, or visual approval.

sourceIdentity.scope: Git-tracked and nonignored workspace files in their current working-tree contents, excluding the listed artifact roots.
sourceIdentity.note: The opened place was built from 0a2e97d; `git diff 0a2e97d..140f132 -- projects/signal-garden` is empty, so the runtime source matches this clean snapshot.

runtime.console: [Signal Garden] Cooperative marsh loop started; live Studio validation remains an explicit release gate.
checks: get_studio_state returned Play with Client and Server DataModels.
Both the server and client Workspace trees contained SignalGarden with RootWalkways, MarshLandmarks, and GameplayNodes.
GameplayNodes contained 18 Parts: eight Echo fragments, the ResonanceArchive, four route cores or altars, and four route switches.
MossSwitchASupport and BloomSwitchBSupport exist under RootWalkways with GameplayRole=CollidableTraversalSupport and CanCollide=true.
The ArchivePlatform top is Y=9 and its X edge is -22; each support top is Y=9 and overlaps the platform by 2 studs.
The console contained the Signal Garden bootstrap message and no error output.
screen_capture returned a 222687-byte JPEG with SHA-256 2198ef5536e0803374fbd19b56ca8f536be7f9819ece6d410439f99a314bd5f7.

hud: Welcome to the marsh. Find three Echoes to charge the archive.

limitations: One local desktop client only; no second player or replication check.
No player input or full gameplay loop was completed; the HUD shows the initial 0/3 state.
Touch, controller, physical-device, and performance behavior were not measured.
No place change was saved, no asset was uploaded, and nothing was published.
The place and game IDs were not exposed by the read routes; this is a local unpublished place.
No independent reviewer is attached; this record supports only the narrow checks it names.
